title: alea-intake — Persona UAT Campaign (live validation)
description: Live end-to-end validation of the intake pipeline. Rounds 1-3 vs v1.1/v1.2 (see history sections). 2026-07-10 Damien locked rubric v1.3 (strictest option on all four rulings). Round 4 (first v1.3 judging): 2/6, 2/6, 5/6. Round 5a (deploy b9531e8): IMM 6/6 first clean pass; LT 5/6, FC 5/6. Rounds 5b/5c (deploys 689eeb3/00236fd, this update): ALL THREE core personas PASS all 6 gates - LT 6/6 (mean 2.23), IMM 6/6 (2.29), FC 6/6 (2.35). Decision gate cleared -> pre-authorized round-6 expansion ran 5 new personas on 5b25a70: elder-exploitation 4/6 BORDERLINE, wage-theft 3/6, benefits-denial 2/6, employment-discrimination 2/6, consumer-debt 1/6 - all sunk by pre-registered generalization gaps (MN-scoped deadline rule table force-fit onto foreign domains; doctrine-probe cross-domain bleed; five practice areas with no rules).
spend: App-side (gpt-4o-mini) 2026-07-10/11 session: ~3x 3-persona runs + 1 LT re-run + 5-persona expansion ~= $4.5-6; campaign total across all rounds ~= $9-11. Judging is orchestration-side (11 opus judge subagents this session). $10 session cap respected.
environment: Railway alea-intake-dev (gpt-4o-mini). Core-persona verdicts on deploys 689eeb3 (IMM/FC round-5b) and 00236fd (LT round-5c); expansion round-6 on 5b25a70. Deploy verified via /health before every run.

sections.title: Campaign result — rounds 5b/5c: ALL 3 CORE PERSONAS PASS 6/6 (LOCKED v1.3)
sections.body: First full-campaign pass. landlord-tenant 6/6 PASS mean 2.23 (round-5c, deploy 00236fd, docs 105-107); immigration 6/6 PASS mean 2.29 (round-5b, deploy 689eeb3, docs 99-101); family-custody 6/6 PASS mean 2.35 (round-5b, deploy 689eeb3, docs 102-104). Judged by 3 independent opus subagents vs LOCKED v1.3 + ANSWER-KEYS + folio_check + memo_checks. Movement: round-4 2/6, 2/6, 5/6 -> round-5a 5/6, 6/6, 5/6 -> rounds 5b/5c 6/6, 6/6, 6/6. The four strict rulings are all satisfied live: r1 doctrine depth via the deterministic probe table (VAWA, U-status/I-918B, 245(c)(2)+VAWA-exemption linkage, Pereira NTA defect, asylum one-year-bar exceptions, OFP 518B.01, 518.17 subd.1(a)(4) DV custody factor, flight-risk, retaliation, deposit 504B.178, rent escrow 504B.385, defective notice); r2 lapsed asylum bar computed 2020-08-14 + flagged + routed to INA 208(a)(2)(D) with the notario-fraud hook; r3 every computed deadline pin-cited (504B.321 subd. 1a, 504B.135, 518.12, 8 C.F.R. 1003.18/INA 239, INA 208(a)(2)(B),(D)); r4 executive_summary non-empty in all 9 exports. Fabrication sweeps clean on all three.

sections.title: Round-6 expansion (5 new personas, deploy 5b25a70) — decision-gate authorized, verdicts MIXED
sections.body: Expansion ran because all 3 core personas passed all 6 gates. Verdicts (first-ever runs, no baselines): elder-exploitation 4/6 BORDERLINE mean 1.61 (docs 120-122; fails 04+09); wage-theft 3/6 FAIL mean ~1.2 (111-113; fails 04, 08, 09); benefits-denial 2/6 FAIL mean 0.90 (114-116; fails 01, 04, 08, 09); employment-discrimination 2/6 FAIL mean 1.35 (117-119; fails 01, 04, 08, 09); consumer-debt 1/6 FAIL mean 0.84 (108-110; fails 01, 04, 05, 08, 09). RUB-15 passed on ALL 8 personas (exec summaries + substance everywhere); folio_check 42/42; exports_ok 8/8. Three coherent root causes, all pre-registered generalization risks of the v1 MN-scoped rule set - NOT regressions of the core fixes: (1) DEADLINE-RULE DOMAIN CONTAMINATION [BUG-32]: mn_family_response_30d applies to ANY MN served-event (fired 518.12 on employment terminations, UI determinations, POA signings); stated_court_date labels private/agency dates 'the court's own summons' (realtor appointment, severance deadline, UI determination); generic_notice_window cites 'notice or lease' on debt letters and bank letters -> RUB-09(d) auto-fails + RUB-04 phantom-matter fabrications ('a default could be entered against you') on all 5. (2) DOCTRINE-PROBE CROSS-DOMAIN BLEED [BUG-33]: the OFP/custody probes mis-fired on wage-theft (DV banner + 'What you described - being physically hurt' with zero DV facts) and elder-exploitation ('between the parents') - probe predicates need domain scoping and question text must not assert its own predicate. (3) MISSING DOMAIN RULES [BUG-34]: FDCPA 1692g validation window (computed from letter date not receipt, wrong by 5 days), MN 6-yr SOL restart trap (541.05/541.053) absent, UI appeal 268.105 (right date, wrong authority) + 268.095 subd. 6(b) carve-out absent, EEOC 300-day/MDHR 1-year windows absent, elder 609.2334 freeze + 626.557 MAARC absent. DECISION: expansion findings routed to next round with Damien - core-persona v1.0 UAT close stands on the 6/6 x3 result.

sections.title: Bugs FIXED this round (verified live, commits on master)
sections.body_html:
• BUG-18 [RUB-15] — JSON exports were empty shells: generation persisted only markdown; export rebuilt an EMPTY OutputContext. Fix: serialize the final post-adaptation context into rendered_json at generation (c8f49cd). Sidecars persona_run.py/memo_checks.py now assert json_substance so an empty shell hard-fails RUB-15 (996c896).   • BUG-19 — rewriter refusals ('It seems there was an issue with the text provided...', 'I'm sorry, but I cannot assist') returned as SUCCESSFUL completions and leaked into memos/PDFs as claim conclusions. Fix: refusal-signature detection fails closed to the unrewritten prose, logged server-side (4bb1888). Verified: 0 leaks across all round-3 memos.
  • BUG-20 — DV persona lacked the DV hotline. Three root causes fixed (a176265): substring keyword matching ('ice' fired inside police/Office/Justice/notice/service -> word-boundary matching); DV protocol only matched formal phrases (added lay-DV keywords/regex: 'left a bruise', 'don't you dare call the cops'); assembler guardrail guarantees the National DV Hotline whenever the DV/abuse/stalking domain is active. Verified: memos 63/64/65 lead with 1-800-799-7233, immigration orgs gone.
  • BUG-21 [RUB-05] (partial — issue_spot lane) — semantic-fit validation stage added to claim mapping (27917a4): tier-1 deterministic geographic/placeholder/branch rejection + tier-2 single batched gpt-4o-mini context-fitness call with confidence recalibration; wrong mappings drop the IRI. NOT yet covering the exploration lane — see BUG-22.

Defense-in-depth also shipped: gap batch capped to top-20 by priority (ab99acd), legal-aid prompt framing + deterministic fallback questions on LLM failure or valid-but-empty result (50f97f9, dc419e9). Verified: immigration run 34 has 9 questions, latest_stage=question_gen.
